All work is complete and verified. Final handoff:

## Summary — GC segmented-delivery integration + retention-read finish

**Scope (exclusive):** `internal/store/gcrun.go`, new `internal/store/gc_delivery_segments.go`, and the `gc_retention_read_*` / `gc_delivery_segments` tests + `gc-segment-integration-work.md`. No daemon import, no producer mutation, **no rollover enablement**. The producer wire is unshipped; the decoder is dormant on every current (legacy) store.

**First: preserved the interrupted run.** `gc-segments-fix-2` (FAILED, before my fixes) and `gc-retention-r2-suite2` (killed mid-run, "running", 0-byte log) are stale artifacts, kept as evidence, not repeated.

**Part A — finished prior round.** Fixed a real Windows bug: `os.SameFile(os.Lstat, handle)` is always false (FindFirstFile lacks the file-id), which halted every lease harvest → now uses handle-based `rootedLstat`. Added `maintNoFollow(s.root, path)` full-ancestor confinement (immediate-parent `os.Root` alone followed an aliased grandparent), a `maxRetentionSources` ceiling, and moved the enumeration budget check to *after* each batch (an empty dir must not truncate on an expired deadline).

**Part B — segment decoder.** Byte-exact read-only mirror of the daemon authority: chained log + head, **dense `active==seq`**, **four files per committed segment** (lease + ack + both position seals, seals validated format-independently), head names an exact record on a byte boundary, complete tail = newer authority (no write), **stable frontier over head AND log rechecked after the whole harvest** (a committed log tail lands before the head checkpoint), committed sources marked `required` (mid-harvest disappearance halts), cross-segment ACK settle, staged segments conservatively retained, legacy trees unchanged, migration-evidence-without-authority/torn/conflicting → halt (never revert to legacy).

**Also found & fixed:** a `present`/`missing` bool inversion that halted legacy stores.

**Verification (run.py, exact status):**
- Negative controls: `gc-segments-negctl` (pre-integration reader) **FAIL**; `gc-segments-r3-newchecks-negctl` (seal/dense/frontier neutered) **FAIL** — each new check proven load-bearing.
- `gc-segments-r3-1` **PASS**; `gc-segments-r3-2` **PASS** (11/11 segment tests); `gc-r3-broad` **FAIL** (caught the deadline regression → fixed); `gc-r3-deadline` **PASS**; `gc-r3-broad2` **PASS** (full GC/retention/segment/compact/loadroots suite, 104 s).
- `gofumpt -l` clean; `go vet ./internal/store` = 0; `GOOS=linux go build ./internal/store` = 0.

**Limitations returned to main (no acceptance claim):** cross-package producer-agreement test is **owed**; seal check is structural, not semantic; the post-harvest frontier recheck is unit-verified for the static case but a live concurrent-rotation test is owed; the Unix FIFO test is compile-verified but **not executed** on this Windows host (store test binary links the daemon); residual concurrent-swap/FIFO races remain (documented); rollover stays off.
